message.level:
Whether you’re waiting out Bay Area traffic before our events or simply want to get things done alongside good people, join us on Tuesday afternoons for our newly revamped, free community co-working gathering. We’ll have tea, light snacks, and a shared container for focused, companionable productivity with fellow members of the Alembic community. Bring some snacks to share if you can!

Upon arrival, please remove your shoes and there's no need to check in. Simply find the WiFi on the board and enjoy co-working. 

This event is free. Please help us by making a donation: https://www.berkeleyalembic.org/donate
